citation.title: Effects of 8 days of water-only fasting on stress, anxiety and cognitive performance in men with fasting experience

population.description: Fourteen men aged 35-60 (enrolment range, not observed min/max) with prior fasting experience, no acute or chronic physical or mental illness, non-smokers; the pooled group (younger n = 6 and elder n = 8, split at age 48). Age and BMI are the pooled 'Together' values of Table 1 (BMI before the fast).

protocols.name: before_fast
protocols.description: Fasted morning sample before the 8-day water-only fast (volunteers reported to the laboratory in the morning in the fasting state; hours of fasting, clock hour and sampling time not printed). Assumed: 08:00, 10 h fasted, 30-minute arm read at minutes 29-30.

protocols.name: after_8d_fast
protocols.description: Morning sample after 8 days of water-only fasting (mineral water ad libitum). The paper gives no hours and no clock time: the men were already fasted overnight at the first visit and began the 8 days after that visit's tests, and the procedures were 'repeated' after the 8 days. Assumed, not printed: last meal about 10 h before the first morning sample (the same assumption as the before arm) + 8 days x 24 h = 10 + 192 = 202 h at the second morning sample, 08:00; 30-minute arm read at minutes 29-30. (Counted only from the end of the first visit's tests the fast would be a few hours short of 192 h; the difference is small against 8 days.)
